attr.title: WitchWay
attr.desc: A puzzle-platformer where you play as a little witch trapped in a deep well. Using your magic wand, you manipulate blocks and environmental objects to solve puzzles, navigate hazards, and rescue bunnies.
attr.inst: Place your purchased WitchWay files (WitchWay 1-12 WIN .zip or WitchWay.exe) into the 'witchway/assets' folder. The port will automatically extract and prepare the files on first launch.
attr.inst_md:
1. Purchase WitchWay from [itch.io](https://andrewgleeson.itch.io/witchway).
2. Place `WitchWay 1-12 WIN .zip` (or `WitchWay.exe`) into `ports/witchway/assets/`.
3. Launch the game from PortMaster to auto-extract and play!
